notes: No header row. Date "DD Mon YY"; description quoted with a space at each end; a card field ("n/a" in the one published row); cardholder; a category (may be empty); then two amount fields: spending written negative in the first, payments and refunds positive in the second (which of the two holds which is the least certain part: the one published row has a negative purchase in the first and the second empty). No balance, no currency. Order and line endings unknown (newest first, LF here).
